expansion._doc: Digital tickets are a sample of all riders (cash/ETM, passes and free pink tickets are missing). E = assumed total weekday boardings / observed weekday digital boardings.
expansion._doc_alpha: 0 = same expansion on every route; 1 = assume every bus carries the same riders per day. 0.5 splits the difference.
expansion._doc_anchor: Second anchor: the busiest well-sampled bus-hours (this quantile of load/crush) may not exceed crush load. The lower of the two anchors is used.

fleet._doc: Buses per route are estimated with the Chao1 estimator on vehicle-tagged tickets per day. GTFS frequencies replace this when a feed is supplied.

bus_types._doc: Default 12 m low-floor bus. Routes matching a pattern in nine_m_route_patterns use the 9 m bus.

seat_probability._doc: P(seat) = P(bus load < seats). Bus load is lognormal with the cell's mean, and CV combining day-to-day variation (from data) and bus-to-bus variation within an hour (bunching).

ml._doc: Gradient-boosted smoothing for sparse stretch-hours, blended n/(n+k) with the raw estimate; kept only if it beats the raw estimate on the held-out week 4.

events._doc: Unusual-day detector. Each day vs the median of the same weekday on other normal days. known_events is used ONLY to label and score what the detector found, never to find it. Check the calendar labels before presenting.

bunching._doc: Pair-correlation of bus arrivals at the same stop: pairs 0-3 min apart vs 10-40 min apart. 0 = even spacing, 1 = random, >1 = buses in packs.

feedback._doc: Rider reports via WhatsApp/web are stored in data/feedback.db and compared with the model.
